title: Dar se deti thi
body:
dar se deti thi awaaz maadar
raat hone ko hai aao asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
shaq ab hai judaai ye dil par
raat hone ko hai aao asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna pur haul hai ye biyaban
khauf o dehshat hai kitni rumeinan
darr na jaana kahin mere dilbar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaag kar raat tum ne guzaari
subho se thi ajab bekharari
ab to sojao pehlu mein aa kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab na paaungi pehlu mein tum ko
neend beta na aayegi hum ko
so sakoge na tum bhi bichad kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
teer gardan pa teri laga hai
kya ye sach hai jo maine suna hai
maa ko dikhlao to ran se aa kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo kaha maine tum ne suna tha
aur jawab uska has kar diya tha
hogaye kyun khafa ghar se jaa kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jang maidan mein ki sab ne pyare
par na dekhe thay aise nazaare
kya kiya tum ne roya jo lashkar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya koi kehna un ka na maana
ho ke nazraaz shaah e madina
chod aaye tumhe ran mein sarwar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum na kuch gham karo mere beta
kya hua gar jala tera jhoola
doongi lori mai godhi mein le kar
raat hone ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya malak ne khabar ye sunaayi
sab anees e shahe karbalayi
jaaye jannat mein nauha ye padh kar
raat hone ko hai...
author: Anees
